prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” roofer, but **Gates Enterprises** looks like a strong first call for Denver hail damage: it reports a 4.9-star rating across 348+ Google reviews, four manufacturer certifications, and experience with storm repairs. [Gates’ Denver page](https://www.gatesroof.com/areas/denver)

I’d also get a comparison quote from **Cenco Roofing**—it reports 4.9 stars across 840+ reviews and offers hail inspections. [Cenco’s hail-damage page](https://www.cencoroofing.com/residential-roofing/hail-damage/)

Before signing, get at least three written estimates, verify the contractor’s current Colorado/local credentials and insurance, and ask for a detailed inspection report and workmanship warranty. Don’t feel pressured to sign immediately or let a roofer promise what your insurer will cover.
